scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
other_conditions: Must have completed post‑graduation with a minimum of 55% marks for the fellowship component

Must have admission in regular full‑time M.Phil/Ph.D. programmes in universities or institutes covered under UGC sections 2(f)/12(B), deemed universities, central/state grant‑in‑aid institutions or Institutes of National Importance
For the scholarship component, must be a Scheduled Tribe student admitted to a notified institution and a course approved by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs
Total family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000 per annum (exemptions apply for orphans/guardians) for scholarship eligibility
Applicants must not claim any other central or state scholarship for the same study
Divyangjan (disabled) candidates must provide a disability certificate confirming at least 40% disability
Income certificate (or Form‑16 for salaried candidates) is required at the time of admission for scholarship applicants
An offer letter from the institute must be uploaded with the application
Candidates must register on DigiLocker and the National Tribal Fellowship Portal using Aadhaar and provide the required documents
benefits_summary: Provides fully funded fellowships for M.Phil/Ph.D. and scholarships covering tuition, stipend, and other allowances for Scheduled Tribe students.
